title: Piyaṅkara
text: 1. Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā Anuruddho Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || 2. Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Anuruddho rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya dhammapadāni bhāsati || || 3. Atha kho Piyaṅkara-mātā yakkhinī puttakam evaṃ tosesi || || Mā saddaṃ karī Piyaṅkara || bhikkhu dhammapadāni bhāsati || api ca dhammapadaṃ vijānīya || paṭipajjema hitāya no siyā || || pāṇesu ca saṃyamāmase || sampajānamusā na bhaṇāmase || sikkhema susīlyam attano || api muccema pisāca-yoniyā ti || ||
